title: Terms on Which an Equipment Rental and Demo Reservation Stands
content:
1. A reservation is taken for a stated rider over stated dates, and the number of days must fall between the package's shortest and longest terms.

2. The rider's height, weight, age and ability are what the fitting is worked from, and a rider outside the package's fitting range is moved to the package that does fit them rather than fitted into this one.

3. Kit is set aside only once the security hold has been taken and the sizes are on the agreement.

4. A reservation is held for the package's hold period after the collection date passes, and kit set aside for a reservation nobody comes for is released back to the shop floor.

5. The block of rental days is loaded only while the agreement stands in the confirmed or picked up state.

6. Where the package is only carried at some of the collective's shops, the collection mountain must be one of them, and a guest asking to collect elsewhere is offered the nearest package that shop does carry.

### Note on clause 5

What decides whether the block may be loaded is the standing of the agreement as the collective's records show it at the moment the block is loaded, matched to the one agreement the block belongs to. An agreement standing reserved, overdue, returned, cancelled, uncollected or closed does not carry that standing; an agreement standing confirmed or picked up does.

| Agreement stands | Block of rental days loaded |
| --- | --- |
| reserved | no |
| confirmed | yes |
| picked up | yes |
| overdue | no |
| returned, cancelled, uncollected or closed | no |

### Note on clause 1

The two ends of the term are the package's own. Each package of the Equipment Rental and Demo line carries a shortest term and a longest term, and the days a reservation is written for fall between them.

### Note on clause 2

The four things the fitting is worked from — height, weight, age and ability — are the rider's, and each package of the line is fitted within its own age, height and weight range. A rider whose figures fall outside the range held against the package asked for is moved to the package whose range does hold them.

### Note on clause 6

Not every mountain of the collective carries every package of the line. Where the package asked for is carried at some of the collective's shops only, the mountain named as the collection point is one of those; a guest asking to collect it at a shop that does not carry it is offered the nearest package that shop does carry.
